annotations.title: Follow a block's cross-references in an extraction job's datasheet

description: The cross-references a block prints ('see Table 9', 'Figure 6', 'on page 41'), each resolved: resolution block (the referenced table, figure or heading, with its id, page, box and a text preview), page (only its page is known) or unresolved; the references elsewhere in the document that point at this block; and for a table, its continuation (the table it continues on an earlier page, the tables continuing it, the chain's pages and the caption printed over its first part). Deterministic: reads the job's stored parse (parsed_document_v1), calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; readable jobs are your own, your workspace's TEAM-shared jobs and PUBLIC jobs, as on the REST API. Refusals: NOT_PARSED / PARSE_FAILED (no usable parse stored for this job), PARSE_EXPIRED (past retention), DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE (over 20,000 blocks). Every block, cell and word comes with its page, box ([x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points, origin top-left), quoted text and parse {document_sha256, parser_version, block_id, cell_id}; block ids are stable only within one parser_version.

block_id.description: A block id from another of these tools (e.g. 'p36-b4-1a2b3c'); stable within one parser_version.

job_id.description: An extraction job in your account (or shared with it).
